notes:
Reports as they come: each OPTiC BOT account can keep, read or delete each kind of report as it arrives, set in Edit profile or Bulk edit (OPTiC BOT 1.0.357 and later). When OPTiC cannot start, it now says why and saves the details for support.

OPTiC BOT 1.0.358: the training hero is the mayor while it is in a city, the windows on one PC take turns logging in and wait together when the game stops answering, buildnpc says in the log why it is waiting, and NEAT classic looks more like NEAT. Open one bot window yourself and click Update to get it, or download it: https://github.com/OPTiC-DEV-AGE1/optic-bot-releases/releases/latest
